title: Persist recovered marketplace locators without false verification
guarantees: Recovered marketplace item IDs can be persisted as research candidates without changing sale verification state.
Secondary-source identity observations cannot make a candidate evidence-eligible.
Secondary-source sale-event observations cannot make a candidate evidence-eligible.
Persisted candidate status is recomputed in CI against the live queue, product identity and market record.
Candidate files cannot carry original-marketplace-verified state.
No market sale price, EV contribution or current verification flag is changed by this step.
